CREATE TABLE "public"."ActivityAudit" (
  "action" "AuditAction" NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "examId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta" jsonb,
  "summary" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "timestamp" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ClassSection" (
  "className" text NOT NULL,
  "classTeacherId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "section" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Exam" (
  "academicYear" text NOT NULL,
  "consolidationLocked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "consolidationLockedAt" timestamptz,
  "consolidationLockedById" text,
  "consolidationMaxMarks" int4 DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marksEntryDeadline" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "term" text NOT NULL,
  "type" "ExamType" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Mark" (
  "enteredById" text NOT NULL,
  "examId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marksObtained" float8,
  "outcome" "MarkOutcome" DEFAULT 'SCORED'::"MarkOutcome" NOT NULL,
  "practicalMarks" float8,
  "status" "MarkStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"MarkStatus" NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MarkAudit" (
  "changedById" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "markId" text NOT NULL,
  "newValue" float8 NOT NULL,
  "oldValue" float8,
  "reason" text,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "timestamp" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MarkEntryAccessRequest" (
  "classSectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "examId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" "MarkEntryAccessKind" DEFAULT 'LATE_ENTRY'::"MarkEntryAccessKind" NOT NULL,
  "message" text,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" "MarkEntryAccessStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"MarkEntryAccessStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "teacherId" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "link" text,
  "meta" jsonb,
  "readAt" timestamptz,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" "NotificationType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Period" (
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isBreak" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PortalAccessLink" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "examId" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "studentIds" text[] NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "PortalAccessLink_studentIds_elem_not_null_43360d76" CHECK (array_position("studentIds", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RefreshToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."School" (
  "address" text,
  "affiliationNo" text,
  "alternatePhone" text,
  "board" text,
  "city" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "distinctionMin" float8 DEFAULT 90 NOT NULL,
  "district" text,
  "email" text,
  "establishedYear" int4,
  "examWeights" jsonb,
  "gradeBands" jsonb,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joinCode" text NOT NULL,
  "logoBytes" bytea,
  "logoMimeType" text,
  "motto" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passPercent" float8 DEFAULT 50 NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "pincode" text,
  "principalName" text,
  "recognitionNo" text,
  "shortName" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text,
  "status" "SchoolStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"SchoolStatus" NOT NULL,
  "udiseCode" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  "workingDays" jsonb,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Student" (
  "academicYear" text DEFAULT '2025-26' NOT NULL,
  "classSectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "dob" timestamptz,
  "guardianName" text,
  "guardianPhone" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "promotedFromId" text,
  "rollNo" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "StudentStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"StudentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."StudentSubjectEnrollment" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subject" (
  "className" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isElective" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "maxMarks" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "practicalMaxMarks" int4,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TeacherAssignment" (
  "classSectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TimetableEntry" (
  "classSectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "dayOfWeek" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "periodId" text NOT NULL,
  "room" text,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "teacherId" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mustChangePassword" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" "Role" NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" text,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
